prompt.description: Self-contained task; parent conversation is not copied.

backend.description: Worker backend; default pi. claude-code runs a Claude model (Sova's Claude catalog) on Sova's tools, as a pi worker on the Claude Code provider.

backendOptions.description: Backend-specific options. claude-code: permissionMode bypassPermissions/dontAsk (no change) or plan (read-only tools); nothing else.

model.description: Backend model ID. Pi: exact provider/model, defaults to parent. Other backends use their own defaults.

cwd.description: Working directory, resolved relative to the parent cwd.

wake.description: When the worker settles and you are idle, start a turn so you can act on the result. Default true; false only queues the result for your next turn.

extensions.description: Extension sources the child loads (path, or an installed npm:name or git:host/repo; nothing is installed at spawn), e.g. ["npm:pi-web-access"] for web tools. Children load no extensions otherwise; this extension itself is refused.

fork.description: Start the child from a copy of this conversation's full history instead of a fresh context. Requires a persisted parent session.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers this worker gets, by name: only ones this chat has, with its tools as trimmed here. None named: it has none. Not part of tools.

useWorktreeConfig.description: Pi only: run the worker on its worktree's own agent dir (<worktree>/.agent: its settings, auth and mode extension, normal mode + spec). Valid only when cwd is inside an active worktree this session tracks that has a .agent.
